newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Stefanel managers in fraud probe.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Stefanel managers in fraud probe.

text.p: A group of executives at Italian clothing company Stefanel are under investigation for false accounting and tax evasion, a source at the Italian state prosecutor's office confirmed on Wednesday.

The source speaking by telephone from the north eastern town of Treviso where Stefanel is based said 17 notifications of investigation from the Treviso prosecutor's office had been sent to managers and directors at the company last July.
Stefanel shares were 5.28 percent down on the Milan stock market at 1115 GMT, after touching a session low of 1,480 lire (91 cents) per ordinary share.
News of an investigation has only just been reported by local press. Reports said the probe concerned tax irregularities regarding the books of some foreign subsidiaries of Stefanel.
"The allegations are false accounting and tax evasion for accounts in the years 1991 to 1993. The investigation is continuing," the source said.
Magistrate Bruno Bruni is in charge of the investigation which also involves inquiries by Venice-based tax police.
But a press spokesman for Stefanel denied that any formal notification of investigation had been received by company executives and the company will issue a statement later.
